verdicts.reason: A loses the headline, URL and 'HO SMART' wordmark entirely, leaving a blank blue band. Its logo icon is detached and sits faint grey on white above the band, so the ad has no message or brand and can't be used. B keeps everything intact but is just the original banner shrunk into a thin strip across the middle of the square, with about 75% of the canvas left as empty white above and below. The headline and URL are small, and the layout was never rearranged for the square format.
